'''December 2000 Helmond tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held in Helmond, Netherlands on 10 December 2000. It is known from Maarten Rossou's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1547">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-15-hellmond-the-netherlands-101200d1547/ hellmond-the-netherlands-101200], DeckTech (Maarten "PIET" Rossou, 15 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-15-hellmond-the-netherlands-101200d1547/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Helmond, Netherlands
* '''Format:''' [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck (format)]]
